blocks.text: Simple lipids fatty acids ke mukhtalif alcohols ke saath esters hain. Alcohol ki qism ke lihaz se inhein mazeed qismon mein baanta jata hai: fats (charbi), oils (teil) aur waxes (mom).

Jaanwaron ki charbi aur nabati teil glycerol ke aik molecule aur teen fatty acids se bane esters hain; inhein triglycerides kehte hain (Figure 27.10). Teeno fatty acids aik jaise bhi ho sakte hain aur mukhtalif bhi. Yeh banawat inhein energy jama karne wale behtareen molecules banati hai; yeh jism ko insulation (garmi rokne wali teh), aaza (organs) ki hifazat aur charbi mein ghulne wale vitamins bhi deti hai.

Saturated fatty acids (jin mein sirf single bonds hon) aise lipids banate hain jo kamre ke temperature par thos (solid) hon; inhein fats kehte hain. Oils mein unsaturated fatty acids hote hain jin mein aik ya zyada double bonds hon.

Fatty acid zanjeerein hydrophobic hain, is liye fats paani mein nahi ghulte lekin organic solvents mein ghul jate hain. Jism mein isi khoobi ki wajah se yeh jild ke neeche insulation ki tahein aur gurdon (kidneys) jaise aaza ke gird gaddi (cushion) banate hain, jo temperature qabu rakhne aur hifazat mein madad dete hain.

blocks.alt: Glycerol, teen carbon ki zanjeer jis par teen OH groups hain, aur teen fatty acids, har aik lambi zigzag carbon zanjeer jis ke sire par COOH group hai. Teer triglyceride tak jata hai: glycerol ki har oxygen aik zanjeer ke C=O carbon se juri hai, 'fatty acid residue'.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.10: Glycerol aur fatty acids mil kar triglycerides banate hain (kitab ki Figure 27.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Glycerol ke teen OH groups mein se har aik aik fatty acid ke COOH se ester bond banata hai; har bond par aik paani ka molecule nikalta hai, yani triglyceride bante hue teen H₂O nikalte hain. Product mein har zanjeer 'fatty acid residue' kehlati hai kyun ke us ka OH nikal chuka hai.

Zyada tar waxes lambi fatty acid zanjeeron aur lambi zanjeer wale alcohols ke esters hain. Dono zanjeerein non-polar aur hydrophobic (paani ko door karne wali) hain. Isi wajah se waxes hifazati teh (coating) bana kar rukawat ka kaam karte hain aur paani ko satah par chipakne nahi dete. Qudrat mein misalein: shehed ki makhi ka mom (beeswax), whale ke sar ka teil, kuch aabi parindon ke par aur paudon ka mom. Dawa saazi (pharmaceutical), cosmetics aur doosri sanaton mein inhein lotions, marham (ointments) aur polish banane mein bohat use kiya jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab beeswax ka ester CH₃–(CH₂)₃₄–CO–O–(CH₂)₃₅–CH₃ chhapti hai; yeh 72 carbon wala ester hai jo bohat lamba hai. Beeswax ke esters mein taqreeban 40 se 52 carbon hote hain; aam ahem ester myricyl palmitate, CH₃(CH₂)₁₄COO(CH₂)₂₉CH₃, hai (oopar likha gaya).

blocks.prompt: Kamre ke temperature par zaitoon ka teil maaye (liquid) aur makhan thos kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Zaitoon ke teil ke triglycerides mein zyada tar unsaturated fatty acids hain jin ke C=C bonds zanjeeron ko mor dete hain, is liye molecules qareeb qareeb nahi jam sakte; makhan mein zyada saturated fatty acids hain jin ki seedhi zanjeerein qareeb jam jati hain.

items: Simple lipids: fatty acids aur alcohols ke esters (fats, oils, waxes).
Triglycerides: glycerol + 3 fatty acids; fats (saturated, thos), oils (unsaturated, maaye).
Waxes: lambi zanjeer ka fatty acid + lambi zanjeer ka alcohol; paani se bachane wali teh.
